verdict: Alphabet raised FY2026 AI capex to $195-205B, AMD launched Helios/MI455X, TSLA crushed -15% on Q2 EPS miss, NOW surged +5% on beat — no infra slowdown, mixed on consumer/EV.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**Signal 1 — DRAM Pricing (TrendForce Jul 9):** Server DRAM +13-18% QoQ in 3Q26 — positive but sharply decelerating from Q1's +81%. LTAs cap headline upside; non-hedged buyers see higher spot exposure. Memflation slowing, not reversing.

**Signal 2 — HBM4 / Post-2026:** No correction signals. TrendForce (Jun 2): HBM contract prices to "surge multiples" in 2027. Key wrinkle: SK Hynix deliberately **slowing HBM4 ramp to redirect wafers to DDR5** — DDR5 margins briefly exceeded HBM per-wafer profitability. Micron HBM4 ramping 2x faster than HBM3E did. All 2026 HBM sold out. Consensus: tightness deepens through 2027.

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler Capex (FRESH Jul 22):** Alphabet Q2: $119.8B revenue (+24% YoY), Google Cloud +82% YoY. **FY2026 capex raised to $195-205B** (from $180-190B); FCF went negative (-$5.9B). GOOGL fell 3.65% AH — market punished the raise. Big-4 total 2026 AI capex now tracking $730-750B. **MSFT, META, AMZN all report Jul 29-30 — next major read.**

**Signal 4 — AMD / Custom Silicon (FRESH Jul 22):** AMD "Advancing AI 2026": **MI455X** (40 PF FP4, 432 GB HBM4, 19.6 TB/s bandwidth), **Helios rack** ($5.25M, 72x MI455X, ~3 exaflops FP4). OpenAI + Meta booked 12 GW combined; Azure + Oracle named early customers; Anthropic investment deal also announced. H2 2026 ramp confirmed. AMD stock: +4% on Jul 21 Microsoft Azure deal, then -2.3% on keynote (buy-rumor-sell-news). AWS Trainium 3 mass-production ramp active, Q3 ASIC targets raised 20-30%.

**Signal 5 — Optical:** LITE +9%+ (Jul 21) on Barclays Overweight upgrade ($1,000 PT). COHR set Aug 12 earnings (guided above consensus, +221% YTD). CIEN fell 14% after Q2 beat — multiple compression, not demand weakness. CPO penetration ~0.5%, on baseline trajectory.

**Signal 6 — Solar:** No breaking news this week. ENPH earnings Jul 28, FSLR Jul 30, ARRY Aug 5. Section 201 tariffs expired Feb 2026; 10% Section 122 baseline now in effect. Polysilicon ~$4.82/kg, still drifting lower. US DC power demand reached 42 GW in 2026; hyperscalers signed 40+ GW solar contracts in 2025. Structural tailwind intact.

---

| NOW | +5% | Q2 beat-and-raise: $3.99B revenue (+24%), EPS $0.90 vs $0.76 est; AI ACV crossed $1B; agentic AI deployments +9x in 9 months; FY guide raised |

| AMD | +4% → -2.3% | +4% on Microsoft Azure/Helios deal (Jul 21); -2.3% on keynote day (Jul 22, sell-the-news) |

No notable movers in: NVDA, COHR, FSLR, ENPH, NXT, ZS, CRM, SNOW, GDDY, RMBS, STX, AMPX, ALMU.

---

## Context vs Baseline

- **HBM correction risk (baseline #1 flag):** Zero evidence. SK Hynix DDR5 redirect *tightens* HBM supply — opposite of glut scenario. Consensus through 2027 is shortage, not correction. ✓
- **Hyperscaler capex baseline ($600-700B):** Now tracking $730-750B — upside surprise confirmed. ✓
- **AMD MI400/Helios H2-2026:** Confirmed on schedule. ✓
- **NVIDIA custom ASIC share-shift:** Underway but additive, not yet disruptive; NVDA still supply-constrained.
- **TSLA:** Earnings miss is consumer/EV-specific, unrelated to AI infrastructure thesis.

---

| AMD / custom silicon | MI400/Helios H2 confirmed; AWS Trainium ramp | Bull AMD; mild NVDA share-shift risk in 2027 |
| Optical | LITE strong; CIEN valuation reset | Mixed |
| Solar | Pre-earnings quiet; structural DC tailwind intact | Neutral/watch |

---

## Most Important Development

**TSLA -15% on Q2 EPS miss** is the largest watchlist name move. Separately, **AMD Helios/MI455X launch + Alphabet capex raise (both Jul 22)** confirm AI infra spend is accelerating. MSFT/META/AMZN printing Jul 29-30 is the next critical read — if they also raise capex guides, the $730-750B consensus goes higher and is bullish for MU, MRVL, CRDO, ALAB, COHR, LITE. Jensen Huang naming Marvell "the next trillion-dollar company" is the most bullish hyperscaler-naming event on the watchlist this week.
